correctness.rationale: For every intuitionistic formula, forcing is an upset by structural induction; this includes both modalities since each quantifies over all future worlds. For upset U_t=[t,n), a nonempty neighbourhood A is a subset iff min A>=t and intersects iff max A>=t. The source modal clauses reduce exactly to t<=B_i for Box and t<=D_i for Diamond where B_i=min_v>=i max_A min A and D_i=min_v>=i min_A max A. Centredness ensures B_i<=i<=D_i and monotonicity of suffix minima; both are realised by N*(i)={[B_i,D_i]}. All modalities therefore act identically on all upsets, and simultaneous formula induction establishes equivalence at arbitrarily nested depths. Distinct thresholds are separated by a principal upset valuation of Box p or Diamond p at depth one. Each monotone sequence on its respective side of i is enumerated by Catalan_n, independently, giving squared count. Fresh independent direct counts n1..6 =1,4,25,196,1764,17424; package verifier independently checks all 1/9/3375 raw frames for n1..3, not used to prove all n. Checked original Dalmonte–de Groot Definition 2.3 on accessible primary full text: actual Box/Diamond clauses are precisely those used here.
